description: Brühlstraße 2, 55469 Simmern/Hunsrück: rail datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Brühlstraße 2, 55469 Simmern/Hunsrück. Coverage: Brühlstraße 2, 55469 Simmern/Hunsrück. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about rail; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Industriegebiet Am Bahnhof; Am Bahnhof und Umfeld - Teil A; Am Bahnhof und Umfeld - Teil B. Formats seen: WMS. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
